objective: Isolated DEV Smart Drawer note classification, local file imports, and user-owned encrypted portable cloud backup/restore; no BUKLOD-hosted storage or production release.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Compared Drawer files and existing per-workstream scope against GitHub main during 2026-11-10 development. Live production Android fingerprint and OTA runtime were not verified; this DEV scope cannot authorize production publishing.
acceptanceChecks: Default local-only Drawer requires no cloud provider subscription and does not send user files to BUKLOD servers.
More precise type classification and explicit manual override preserve existing notes and reminders.
Android local file imports retain supported original attachments and isolate user storage.
Manual backup generates user-owned 256-bit AES key, encrypts archive with AES-GCM and shares only encrypted content.
Restoration checks authentication/account identity and integrity, skips duplicate items, protects existing files.
Node regression tests, Jest, TypeScript compilation, device backup/restore and privacy tests pass before RC.
No Google OAuth, continuous sync, native build or production OTA is represented as complete.
